Original peptides from sheet2 of the OarX paper supplement (PMC11223231; DOI 10.1021/acsomega.4c03514) and a separately acquired reviewed FabG comparison panel. The supplied target is C. glutamicum ATCC 13032 fig:196627.14.peg.708. The paper's perturbation strain ATCC 14067 is a different subject. Publication names select leads; they do not establish molecular activity. The exact supplementary workbook and original acquisition metadata are preserved.
